# Prime Construction & Remodeling

> Design-build remodeling based in Austin, Texas. Kitchens, bathrooms, additions and whole-home renovations, with one company holding the contract and one project manager keeping you involved from the first walkthrough to the final punch list.

- Phone: (512) 948-9398

## Services
- Kitchen remodels: Same-footprint updates or full layout changes, with custom cabinets, countertops, backsplash, flooring and islands.
- Bathrooms & primary suites: From a refresh of a hall bath to a primary suite with a walk-in or steam shower, freestanding tub and custom vanity.
- Additions & ADUs: Room additions and detached guest houses or casitas, from foundation and framing to the last finish.
- Whole-home renovation: Down to the studs, often for buyers renovating before they move in, managed as one project.
- Outdoor living & decks: Decks, pool surrounds, stairs and covered spaces built for Texas summers, with lighting for evenings outside.
- Custom cabinetry & design: Cabinetry built to the room, plus help with the layout and finishes through the design studios we work with.

## About
Prime Construction & Remodeling was founded in 2013 by Jesse Dadon. Jesse is a second-generation builder with a background in civil engineering, and his father's four decades in residential and commercial construction are still a resource on our most demanding projects. We work design-build: one company holds the contract and one point of contact stays with you from the first drawing to the final walkthrough. We coordinate the architect, engineer and showroom, and our project managers notice the little details and suggest changes that make the space better. Homeowners mention Jesse, Dori and Sean by name, and crews led by Benjamin and Julio. We stay within about an hour of the office, from central Austin and the hill country to Cedar Park, Round Rock and Georgetown, so the crew that starts your house is the crew that finishes it. We are a NARI member, carry full insurance, and back every job with a two-year workmanship warranty and a lifetime warranty on our fiberglass shower pans.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you handle the design as well as the build?
  A: Yes. We are a design-build firm. We can rework a layout so it fits how you actually live, coordinate the architect and engineer when a project needs them, and work with several design studios so choosing finishes and materials is easy.
- Q: Are you licensed and insured?
  A: We carry full insurance and are a member of NARI, the National Association of the Remodeling Industry. Texas does not issue a state general contractor license; the plumbers and electricians we use hold their own trade licenses, and permits are pulled in our name.
- Q: What warranty do you offer?
  A: Two years on workmanship and a lifetime warranty on our fiberglass shower pans for as long as you own the home. Manufacturer warranties on appliances, fixtures and materials pass through to you.
- Q: How long does a kitchen remodel take?
  A: A kitchen is usually five to eleven weeks on site, and design and pricing take one to four weeks before that. A whole-home renovation runs several months.
- Q: Do you build ADUs and additions?
  A: Yes. We build room additions, second stories, detached ADUs and casitas, and garage conversions, and handle permits through Austin's AB+C portal.
- Q: Where is your office and when are you open?
  A: 705 N Bluff Dr, Austin, TX 78745. We are open Sunday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM, and closed Saturday. Call ahead to set up a visit.
